B-CHATOBJ-01.title: Make Reincarnable Chat Objects + one-shot workers real
B-CHATOBJ-01.goal: Convert the product blueprint into runtime/compiler/bootstrap/job/run/test implementation using several narrow disposable workers in parallel.
B-CHATOBJ-01.completion_rule: Ready for parent integration when all required items have at least one terminal run with a durable RETURN, or an explicit real boundary the parent can reconcile.

WI-CC-01.title: Runtime/compiler extension audit
WI-CC-01.purpose: Map exactly how Agent Runtime compiler/network/bootstrap should ingest chat_object_id/work_item_id/batch/run state with minimum invasive change.

WI-CC-02.title: Chat Object + Work Item schema adversarial review
WI-CC-02.purpose: Stress-test the new object model against prior Prometeo continuity/authority/worker designs and identify missing fields or dangerous coupling before deeper implementation.

WI-CC-03.title: Tiny worker launch resolver
WI-CC-03.purpose: Implement/define the smallest bootstrap path for `Prometeo <launch_code>` -> exact durable JOB -> run creation/start.

WI-CC-04.title: Worker Run + batch status compiler
WI-CC-04.purpose: Design/implement independent run records and derived parent summary so parent can truthfully know 0/6, 3/6, 6/6 without a shared mutable status bottleneck.

WI-CC-05.title: Fresh-chat reincarnation test harness
WI-CC-05.purpose: Build executable/inspectable tests proving a fresh chat can resolve a Chat Object and reconstruct mission/design/rules/frontier/work state without transcript dependence.

WI-CC-06.title: Historical architecture recovery + simplification review
WI-CC-06.purpose: Compare current blueprint to prior Planner/Compiler, Session Return, Recovery Sweep, PREPARE/DIRECT/EXECUTE and Steward/Merger patterns; identify reusable pieces and unnecessary reinvention.

parent_refresh_rule: Derived counts must come from durable JOB/run/RETURN state. Parent may mention worker progress when it changes the useful next action; no noisy heartbeat required.
worker_write_rule: Workers do not mutate this central board during execution. They write independent run/return objects; a compiler/parent refresh derives this board or a runtime view.
